service.savings.faq.1.question: When is interest credited?
service.savings.faq.1.answer: The demonstration forecast is calculated daily and credited monthly. The actual product would disclose its balance rules and capitalization date before opening.
service.savings.faq.2.question: Can a goal be shared with family?
service.savings.faq.2.answer: Yes. The owner chooses participants, contribution permissions and who may view progress; withdrawals remain separately protected.

service.bonuses.faq.title: Reward questions
service.bonuses.faq.1.question: Why are some points pending?
service.bonuses.faq.1.answer: A merchant may still reverse or correct a transaction. Pending points become available after the operation is finalized under the category rules.
service.bonuses.faq.2.question: Where can points be used?
service.bonuses.faq.2.answer: The partner catalog shows the conversion rate, minimum amount and expiry date before redemption.

service.subscriptions.faq.title: Membership questions
service.subscriptions.faq.1.question: Does the annual price renew automatically?
service.subscriptions.faq.1.answer: The demonstration switch only previews pricing. A real activation screen would explicitly show renewal, first charge date and how to disable automatic renewal.
service.subscriptions.faq.2.question: Can a plan be changed later?
service.subscriptions.faq.2.answer: Yes. Before confirmation the bank would show when the new plan starts and how any unused paid period is handled.

service.family.faq.1.question: Can another member see my private purchases?
service.family.faq.1.answer: No. Shared totals and goals are separate from personal transaction history unless a specific product explicitly grants access.
service.family.faq.2.question: How are junior-card limits changed?
service.family.faq.2.answer: An authorized adult edits the selected card’s limits. Sensitive changes may require a separate operation confirmation.

service.support.faq.title: Support and legal questions
service.support.faq.1.question: How do I submit a formal complaint?
service.support.faq.1.answer: Open a tracked request, choose the complaint type and attach evidence. The screen records the filing date, response deadline and escalation route.
service.support.faq.2.question: Are these documents a public offer?
service.support.faq.2.answer: No. This project is a demonstration interface. Legal pages illustrate structure and disclosure patterns but do not create banking obligations.
